# Krikey AI

> > Krikey AI is an AI-powered 3D animation and video creation platform that enables users to generate animated content, mocap animations, and digital invitations with text-to-animation and video-to-animation tools.

Krikey AI Animation Maker provides collaborative video editing, customizable character animations, and FBX export capabilities for integration with Unity, Blender, Unreal Engine, and Roblox. The platform serves content creators, educators, game developers, and marketing professionals seeking efficient animation workflows.

- 3D Animation

## Core Animation Tools

- [How to - Krikey AI](https://www.krikey.ai/how-to): How-to guides for Krikey AI Animation Maker and video editor
- [Free Mocap Animations in an AI Animation Tool](https://www.krikey.ai/create/free-mocap-animations): Create videos with free mocap animations; export to FBX for Blender/Unity
- [Collaborative Video Editing with Krikey AI](https://www.krikey.ai/features/collaborative-video-editing): Real-time team collaboration in cloud-based AI video editor
- [AI Invitation Maker Card Templates](https://www.krikey.ai/create/ai-invitation-maker): Create digital invitations with 3D animation and customizable templates
- [Emoji Art Generator](https://www.krikey.ai/features/emoji-art-generator): Create custom emoji art & animated stickers; export transparent GIFs
- [Animations Mocap gratuites (French)](https://www.krikey.ai/fr/animations-mocap-gratuites): French: Free mocap animations for social media and marketing videos
